div.label: Quick start (optional - pick an example and the form fills itself in)

dialog.p: Tip: DEBIT = what you received or spent on. CREDIT = where it came from. The same amount always goes on both sides.

ol.li: Dashboard - income, expenses, net income, a balanced check, your last 5 entries and two charts.
Journal - press + New transaction: pick the debit account, the credit account and the amount. The same amount always goes on both sides. Search and filter the list; double-click a pencil to edit.
General ledger - choose an account to see its T-account and running balance.
Worksheet - trial balance, adjustments, income statement, balance sheet and net income. Green means debit = credit.
Statements - a ready-made Income Statement and Balance Sheet.
Accounts - add, rename and delete accounts in one place.

dialog.p: Account types: Asset (what you own), Liability (what you owe), Capital (owner's investment), Drawing (owner takes money out), Revenue (money earned), Expense (cost of running). An adjusting entry is recorded at the end of the period: supplies used, insurance expired, depreciation.
Handy: the round buttons at the bottom of the sidebar are Undo (also Ctrl+Z), Color theme, this Guide and Log out. Use CSV, Excel or Print / PDF on any page to hand in your work.
Your work saves automatically. Want an example? Worksheet tab, then Load sample.
